QuestInfo.name: [Convergence] True Form
QuestInfo.0: You defeated all of the monsters in #bLimina#k, but were unable to locate #bGrendel the Really Old#k. Talk to #bElwin#k about picking up the trail.
QuestInfo.2:
The #rBlack Mage#k vanished, and you arrived at the #bworld's end#k. There you encountered #bGrendel the Really Old#k. According to him, before the time of the Transcendents, the worlds of #bMaple World#k and #bGrandis#k were once one. 

An unfamiliar figure arrives...
QuestInfo.1: The space around you keeps changing, but you are certain you are drawing closer to the #rBlack Mage#k.
